name: claudecodex
description: Pick a Claude Code session and continue it in Codex (or send this one to Claude). Already-imported sessions are just synced.

interface.shortDescription: Continue Claude Code sessions in Codex, and back
interface.longDescription: Lists this project's Claude Code sessions, imports the one you pick (or syncs it if it was imported before) and opens it in Codex. Can also send the current Codex thread to Claude Code.
